cards.mood: The piece launches immediately into a high-octane, aggressive atmosphere that sustains relentless intensity throughout the verses and choruses.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars dominate the arrangement, playing fast, palm-muted rhythmic chugging patterns in the verses and shifting to soaring, harmonized melodic leads during the choruses and solo sections.
